_note: The gold of the story worlds (src/hell/gold_loot.gd): one currency, the profile's gold (the same gold the talent reset costs). Chests, vaults, broken crates, room rewards and loose finds throw it out as coins and money bags; a slain enemy's gold rises as a small '+N' with a coin over the body. bag_value = gold in one money bag: an amount below it falls as single coins, from it on as bags plus the rest in coins (23 = 2 bags, 3 coins). spill: the throw out of a chest: speed = ground px/s [min, max], up = px/s upwards [min, max], gravity px/s^2, bounce = share of the fall speed kept on the first bounce, stagger = s between two pieces leaving. magnet_px = from this distance to the hero the gold flies to him, magnet_speed px/s (it speeds up), pick_px = taken at this distance, settle = s after landing before the magnet pulls. fps = coin turn speed. glint_every = s [min, max] between two glints of the gold lying nearest the hero within hear_px. popup: life s, rise px, merge = s in which pickups add up into one '+N', delay = s after an enemy's fall before its '+N' shows, size = its font size (world px; the coin as tall). look: per graphics set the frames (prefix + _f0.._fN), the glint frames (pixel set) and the draw scale of coin and bag (world px per sprite px).
